Question 12(c) [4 marks]: Explain why corporate social responsibility is a key influence on operations management at Optics.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Optics is a manufacturer of frames for glasses including everyday reading frames and sports frames. They have recently introduced new technology to reduce the amount of plastic in each pair of their new product line by 25%.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Provides a detailed explanation of why CSR is a key influence on operations management at Optics
3 marks: Provides an explanation of why CSR is an influence on operations management at Optics
2 marks: Provides some relevant information about CSR linked to Optics
1 marks: Provides some relevant information about CSR

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Corporate social responsibility (CSR) is when a business goes above and beyond the law to engage in social activities. At Optics, CSR is a key influence on operations management as they have recently installed new technology to reduce plastic usage by 25%. This impacts their reputation as a sustainable business and therefore needs careful consideration by operations management. Optics will need to review its material inputs and the transformation process to ensure they are engaging with sustainable practices throughout the business to keep up with evolving consumer expectations.
